# pai bench

Local-model quality check: run the eval sets and real tasks, print the comparison table

```
pai bench <command>
```

Runs the model-eval harness in bench/ against one provider and tabulates the results. Short, easy and hard are sets of small tasks graded by the harness; real tasks are PAI fixes done in throwaway clones and judged by hidden tests. Results and worker logs go under the results root, never into the repo.

```sh
pai bench run --provider gyro-m --reps 3 --real 2
pai bench table --keys gyro-m,gyro-l:gyro-coder-l --ref sonnet:anthropic
```

### pai bench run

Run the sets for one provider under a watchdog

```
pai bench run [options]
```

Runs the sets one after another (local models serve one run at a time) through bench/evalset.sh and bench/realset.sh. Routing is pinned to the provider, escalation and quota retry are off, so a run never falls back to a cloud model. A watchdog watches the worker transcripts and stops the series, logging why, on REWRITE (an answer file written 15 times, see --max-writes), RUNAWAY (more than 60 distinct answer files in one run) or IDLE (no worker activity for --idle seconds, not counting the `pai power wait` between runs). Real tasks are capped per task. Between runs `pai power wait` is called when that command exists. The series log is <results>/series-<key>.log.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--provider NAME` | string | — | Provider under test (required) |
| `--sets LIST` | string | short,easy,hard | Comma list of short, easy, hard |
| `--reps N` | number | 1 | Reps per set |
| `--real N` | number | 0 | Reps of the 5 real PAI tasks (0 = skip) |
| `--key K` | string | — | Results key (default: the provider) |
| `--real-cap MIN` | number | 30 | Minutes one real task may run |
| `--idle SEC` | number | 900 | Stop the series after this many seconds without worker activity |
| `--max-writes N` | number | 15 | Stop the series when one answer file is written this many times |
| `--results DIR` | string | — | Results root (default: $PAI_BENCH_DIR or ~/.cache/pai/bench); never inside the repo |

```sh
pai bench run --provider gyro-m
pai bench run --provider gyro-m --sets easy,hard --reps 3 --real 2 --key gyro-m-night
```

### pai bench table

Print the comparison table (markdown) from the results

```
pai bench table [options]
```

Counts a run only if its route line, its ending provider and its single worker id all name the model. Loop-stopped and killed runs count for pass % but not for time; real tasks over 900 s are left out of s/task. Each entry is KEY, KEY:PROVIDER or NAME=KEY:PROVIDER (provider defaults to the key). --ref adds cloud reference rows from results of the same layout.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--keys LIST` | string | — | Comma list of local results keys (default: every key found) |
| `--ref LIST` | string | — | Comma list of cloud reference keys |
| `--results DIR` | string | — | Results root (default: $PAI_BENCH_DIR or ~/.cache/pai/bench); never inside the repo |

```sh
pai bench table
pai bench table --keys gyro-m,gyro-l:gyro-coder-l --ref sonnet:anthropic,opus:anthropic
```
